methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve LED light bars from 19 in. to 50 in. spanning budget dual-row (Nilight, Auxbeam), mid-tier off-road (Rough Country, Cali Raised, Pro Comp, Putco), and premium/pro-grade (RIGID, Baja Designs, KC HiLiTES, Diode Dynamics, Vision X, Lightforce) tiers, verified 2026-08-09 primarily against manufacturer product pages with authorized-dealer pages used for corroboration and, in several cases, for the only available USD price; the suggested seed entry "Diode Dynamics SS5" does not exist as a standalone light bar (Diode Dynamics sells "SS5" as a 5 in. round pod), so it was mapped to the real current product built from that pod — the SS5 CrossLink 5-Pod 31.5 in. light bar — rather than dropped or invented; the suggested seed "Extreme LED Stealth" could not be resolved to any real manufacturer, product page, or retailer listing after repeated search, so per the no-guessing rule it was replaced with a verified real product, the Putco Luminix 20 in. (P10020), keeping the roster at twelve. Two entries carry a null priceUsd rather than a guessed figure: Lightforce Viper 20 in. (Australian manufacturer, only an AUD retail price could be found, no USD MSRP or USD retailer listing located) and note that all other prices are the clearest single USD figure found, generally a retailer's current price where manufacturers do not display consumer pricing directly. LED count and color temperature are left null on RIGID, Rough Country, Cali Raised, and Lightforce/Vision X entries where the fetched manufacturer/dealer page did not state that specific figure, rather than inferring it from similar competitor products. accessedAt 2026-08-09 throughout.

products.name: RIGID Industries E-Series PRO 20 in. Spot/Flood Combo LED Light Bar
products.priceNote: Current price on rigidindustries.com (SKU 120313, Black housing, Spot/Flood Combo)
products.provenance: RIGID's own product page (SKU 120313) confirms 20 in. length, 25,080 raw lumens, 214W, and a 19°x17° spot/flood combo beam, plus a current-draw figure of 15.29A at 14V. The page does not publish an IP/ingress rating, LED count, or color-temperature figure anywhere in its specs, features, or downloadable-doc sections, so those three fields are left null rather than assumed from RIGID's other product lines. The seed name "Rigid Industries E-Series 20in" maps to RIGID's current E-Series PRO line (the original E-Series was superseded by the PRO platform; RIGID's own site now sells 20 in. bars only under the E-Series PRO name).

products.name: Baja Designs OnX6+ 20 in. LED Light Bar (Driving/Combo)
products.priceNote: SDHQ Offroad current retail (authorized Baja Designs dealer); Baja Designs' own site did not return product-page content on direct fetch

specs.beam_pattern: driving/combo (42°), also offered in spot (9°) and wide cornering

products.provenance: SDHQ Offroad (authorized Baja Designs dealer reproducing manufacturer spec copy) lists the OnX6+ 20 in. as 12 Cree LEDs, 24,920 lm high / 18,460 lm low, 216W/16.6A high / 160W/12.0A low, IP69K rated, with spot (9°), driving/combo (42°), and wide cornering beam options; driving/combo lumens and wattage used as the representative figure since it is the pattern named in the seed listing. Baja Designs' own bajadesigns.com product pages returned 403/bot-blocked responses on direct fetch, so no color-temperature figure could be confirmed from the manufacturer (Baja Designs markets these as neutral white but does not publish a Kelvin spec on the pages that were accessible), so color_temp_k is left null.

products.name: KC HiLiTES FLEX ERA 40 in. LED Light Bar Master Kit
products.priceNote: Current price on kchilites.com for the 40 in. Master Kit (4x 10 in. segments, both lenses, wiring harness)

specs.beam_pattern: combo (pre-installed) + spot lens included in kit

products.provenance: KC HiLiTES' own FLEX ERA 40 in. Master Kit page confirms 31,648 lm at 5000K, 324W high-power draw (plus a separate 36W amber backlight circuit, not counted in the main wattage figure), IP68 sealing, 9-36V operation, and combo/spot beam lenses both included. Modular segment count (4x 10 in.) is documented but individual LED-die count per segment is not published on this page, so led_count is left null. Beam-distance/candela figures (up to 849m / 720,000 cd) are omitted from specs as out-of-scope for this dataset's spec keys.

products.name: Diode Dynamics SS5 CrossLink 5-Pod 31.5 in. LED Light Bar (Sport, White)
products.priceNote: Current price on diodedynamics.com for the 5-pod Sport White CrossLink kit; Pro White version of the same 5-pod bar is $1,999.95

specs.beam_pattern: driving (30°x20°) and combo (70°x30°) selectable via optic

products.provenance: The seed product "Diode Dynamics SS5" is not sold as a standalone light bar; "SS5" is Diode Dynamics' 5 in. round LED pod, which can be linked into modular "CrossLink" light bars. This entry uses the real current 5-pod, 31.5 in. CrossLink bar (Sport tier, White, 6000K) built from that SS5 pod. Diode Dynamics' own page states 4,800 lm and 40W per pod for the Sport tier (5 pods = 24,000 lm raw / 200W total, used here), versus 9,700 lm/90W per pod for the Pro tier; IP69K waterproofing and 6000K (white)/3000K (yellow) color options are stated for both tiers. Exact per-pod LED die count/model was not stated on the fetched page, so led_count is left null.

products.name: Nilight 22 in. 120W Double Row Spot/Flood LED Light Bar
products.provenance: Nilight's own product page confirms 40 LEDs, 120W, 8,400 lm, IP67 waterproofing, and 6,500K color temperature, corroborated by an independent Walmart listing for the same model citing 8,400 lm and IP67. Nilight's page lists the physically measured bar as 19.6 in., while the model is marketed and sold under the "22 inch" name (a common naming convention in this budget segment referring to a nominal size class rather than exact housing length); the marketed 22 in. figure is used to match the product name and seed request, with the measured discrepancy noted here rather than silently resolved.

products.name: Auxbeam 32 in. 5D-PRO Series 270W LED Light Bar
products.priceNote: Current sale price on auxbeam.com, marked down from listed price of $262.99
products.provenance: Auxbeam's own product page (SKU ZD000679) confirms 32 in. length, 33,000 lm, 270W, IP68 rating, 6500K color temperature, and a 51-LED configuration described as "KW3x3 + P8x48" (3 driving-focused KW3 chips plus 48 flood-focused P8 chips) combined in a 5D reflector/lens optic for a combo beam.

products.name: Rough Country 72950BL 50 in. Black Series Curved Dual Row LED Light Bar
products.priceNote: Current retail at Wulf Suspensions (authorized Rough Country dealer); Rough Country's own roughcountry.com product page returned a 403/bot-blocked response on direct fetch
products.provenance: Wulf Suspensions (authorized Rough Country dealer reproducing manufacturer spec copy) confirms 96 high-intensity 3W Cree LEDs, 23,040 raw lumens, 288W total, IP67 waterproofing, and a curved dual-row housing; the same 23,040 lm/288W/96-LED figures are independently corroborated on 4WheelParts' listing for the identical SKU 72950BL. Beam pattern is documented generically as spot/flood combo across retailer copy; no color-temperature figure was found on any fetched source, so color_temp_k is left null rather than assumed.

products.name: Vision X XPR-9M 19 in. LED Light Bar
products.priceNote: Current price at Offroad Alliance (authorized Vision X dealer); visionxusa.com does not display consumer pricing directly
products.provenance: Vision X Europe's product page for the XPR-9M states 476mm (19 in.) length, 9 LEDs at 10W each (90W total), 9,711 raw lumens (6,795 lm effective/measured), a multi-angle "IRIS" optic mix (6.5° to 70° spread across the 9 emitters), and IP68+IP69K sealing; these match the US market XPR-9M spec sheet reproduced on US retailer pages. US price ($544.99) confirmed at Offroad Alliance, a US Vision X dealer, since visionxeurope.com pricing is in GBP and not applicable. No color-temperature figure in Kelvin is published on either fetched page, so color_temp_k is left null.

products.name: Lightforce Viper 20 in. Single Row LED Light Bar (LFLB20S)
products.priceNote: Lightforce is an Australian manufacturer; only an AUD retail price (A$284.00 on au.lightforce.com) could be located. No USD MSRP or USD-denominated retailer listing was found, so priceUsd is left null rather than converted/estimated.
products.provenance: Lightforce's own Australian product page for the Viper 20 in. Single Row (LFLB20S) confirms 20x 5W LEDs (100W total), 9,020 raw lumens, a spot beam rated to 1 lux at 562m, IP68 sealing with a Gore breather vent, 5,800mA current draw at 12/24V, and 5500K color temperature. Price is listed only in AUD (A$284.00); Lightforce's US-facing shoplightforce.shop storefront was not successfully fetched for a USD figure, so priceUsd is null per the no-guessing rule.

products.name: Pro Comp Motorsports Series 30 in. Single Row LED Combo Light Bar (75130)
products.priceNote: Current retail at GU Motorsport (authorized Pro Comp dealer); procompusa.com's own product page does not display a price
products.provenance: Pro Comp's own product page (part 75130) confirms 30x 5W Osram LEDs (150W total), 14,280 raw lumens, a spot/flood combo reflector pattern, IP68 rating rated submersible to 10 ft, and a color temperature stated as a "6000-6500K (Daylight)" range, for which 6250K (the midpoint) is recorded here since no single value is given. procompusa.com does not display a price on its own product page; $276.66 is the price found at GU Motorsport, an authorized Pro Comp dealer.

products.name: Cali Raised LED 32 in. Slim Single Row LED Light Bar
products.provenance: Cali Raised LED's own product page confirms a 32 in. slim single-row bar with 60 LEDs, 30,000 raw lumens, 150W, a spot beam, and IP68 sealing rated to 1.5m submersion. No color-temperature (Kelvin) figure is published on the fetched page, so color_temp_k is left null rather than assumed to be the common 6000K industry default.

products.name: Putco Luminix 20 in. LED Light Bar (P10020)
products.priceNote: Current price at eTrailer.com (authorized Putco dealer); putco.com's own site does not display consumer pricing directly
products.provenance: eTrailer's dealer page for Putco model P10020 (marketed as the "20 in." Luminix) states an actual measured bar length of 21-5/8 in. (22-3/4 in. bolt-to-bolt), 18 diodes at 3W each (54W total), 7,200 effective lumens, a narrow 15° spot beam, and 6000K color temperature. Putco's own product-family page (putco.com) does not restate per-model dimensions but confirms the line-wide IP69K rating, 6000K NICHIA LEDs, and 12/24/36V compatibility, used to fill in ip_rating for this specific SKU. This entry substitutes for the seed "Extreme LED Stealth," which could not be resolved to any real manufacturer or product page after repeated search.
